works.title: Cab Service
works.caption:
LamiRa EV Express – Chennai ↔ Trichy
Created a professional promotional social media creative for LamiRa EV Express, an eco-friendly EV taxi service connecting Chennai and Trichy. The design highlights the ₹3/km pricing, no extra charges, flexible boarding and drop-off options, and key service benefits such as safety, comfort, reliability, and eco-friendly travel.
The creative was designed to communicate the offer clearly, build trust, and encourage customers to book their ride. The project included visual design, marketing-focused messaging, offer presentation, and a strong call-to-action for customer enquiries and bookings.
works.seoTitle: Professional EV taxi ad creative designed by JR Digital Studio for LamiRa EV Express, promoting Chennai-Trichy travel with clear offers and strong branding.

works.title: KTPL 2.0
works.caption: Designed a premium Team Reveal social media creative for The Kings in the KTPL 2.0 (Kairali Thunders Premier League) cricket tournament. The design showcases the team branding, sponsor details, captain, manager, marquee player, and complete squad in a clean and professional layout. The objective was to create an engaging announcement post that builds excitement, strengthens team identity, and delivers all key information in a visually appealing format. The project included sports graphic design, typography, branding, layout planning, and social media optimization for maximum engagement.
